title: The Huawei MatePad Air (2026) is now available in Malaysia and the Middle East
description: The latest Huawei MatePad Air (2026) was unveiled last month alongside the Huawei FreeClip 2 S. If you want to learn more about the tablet, check out our hands-on, which we wrote after a visit to Malaysia to attend the official launch. Huawei MatePad Air (2026) The tablet is now available in Malaysia with a price for the 8/256GB PaperMatte Edition of MYR 3,500 ($860 / €745 / ₹82,500). This includes a keyboard or an M-Pencil Pro in the box. You can find it on the official Huawei Malaysia site. We also spotted it in a few places in the Middle East too, e.g. in Saudi Arabia it...

title: Google reportedly wants to end all Pixel production in China very soon
description: According to a new report, Google wants to stop making any Pixel products in China next year. That includes smartphones, of course, but also smartwatches and earbuds. In recent years Google has been extending its production capacity in Vietnam and India to reduce its reliance on China, but a "significant" portion of Pixel products are still made in China. The 2027 timeline came from Google's successful development and production of Pixel phones in Vietnam this year. Since phones are more complicated to make than smartwatches and earbuds, the company is now confident it can make the full...

title: iPhone 18 Pro's chipset tipped to be 18 percent faster than predecessor
description: The iPhone 18 Pro series is expected to launch next month with Apple's A20 Pro chipset, which is rumored to be manufactured using TSMC's 2nm process. A new leak now claims that the chipset will offer improved performance and efficiency, but at a higher cost than its predecessor. According to tipster Fixed Focus Digital on Weibo, the A20 Pro chipset will deliver around 18% higher performance than the A19 Pro and will use TSMC's new Gate-All-Around (GAA) process. The tipster also claims that the new process will improve power efficiency, with the A20 Pro reportedly consuming up to 30%...

title: Spotify expands User Notes, adds Playlist Notes to its top editor-curated playlists
description: Last month, Spotify added new features like Running Mode and User Notes. Now the streamer is building on the latter idea with Playlist Notes. These will be used by Spotify’s global team of playlist editors to explain the thinking behind the given playlist – why was a song included in this particular list and what makes it culturally relevant? To get the answer to those questions, head to one of the big playlists and hit the Notes button at the top. There is a caveat to this – the Notes feature is available to users (16 and older) in the US, Canada, the UK, Ireland, Australia and New...

title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra render leaks
description: Samsung is expected to unveil the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra alongside the Galaxy Tab S12+ very soon, perhaps in early September, since that's when its previous generation flagship tablets were announced. Ahead of that, today a rather low resolution render that purports to depict the Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra has been leaked, and you can see it below. This confirms that the tablet will have S Pen support and two rear cameras, just like its predecessor. The S12 Ultra's recent listing in the Google Play Console confirmed that it will be offered in both Wi-Fi-only and 5G versions. The tablet was...

title: YouTube revises view counting
description: YouTube creators will soon see higher view counts for their videos as the platform announced a change in the way it handles viewership. From August 24 onward, a view on YouTube will count as soon as the video starts. This is the same metric that was applied to YouTube Shorts last year and the approach used on other platforms like TikTok and Instagram. YouTube explained in a blog post that creators expressed their desire for a unified view counting system which would “eliminate metric confusion” and bring a more accurate assessment of total exposure. Prior to this change, a single...

title: Samsung details the new Warranty and care menu in One UI 9
description: One UI 9, which made its debut on the recently launched Galaxy Z Fold8, Fold8 Ultra, and Flip8, brings with it a new Warranty and care menu in Settings. It is here that you can keep track of your warranty periods and expiration dates across all of your Samsung devices, with the information being consolidated into one place. The device in use is displayed at the top of the screen, including its eligibility for enrollment into Samsung Care+. Below this device you'll find all the others that are linked to your Samsung account, the one you're signed in with. Bixby can be used...

title: Apple is losing the antitrust battle and soon won't be able to charge commissions from external payment platforms
description: Apple has been fighting antitrust regulators across the globe, and it's about to lose yet another battle in the US after trying to take commissions from purchases made on third-party payment platforms.In the latest regulatory filing from Apple itself, the company admits that it may no longer be able to do so. The EU Commission was the first to force Apple to allow third-party app stores on its platform offering a way around the company's official App Store 30% fee on each purchase, including in-app purchases. This way, creators couldn't distribute their content anywhere else and were...

title: Samsung Wallet adds Digital Key support for Volkswagen EVs
description: Today Samsung has announced that Samsung Wallet now supports Digital Key access for Volkswagen EVs, including the ID. Polo, ID. Cross, ID.3neo, ID.4, ID.5, ID.7, and ID. Buzz. This is currently rolling out in Europe for vehicles running ID. software version 6.0.1. Only vehicles produced on or after April 27, 2026 are compatible, and they need to be equipped with the "Preparation for Digital Key" option package. Through this feature you can use a compatible Samsung Galaxy smartphone to lock, unlock, and start your car without having to use a physical key. Digital Keys in Samsung...

title: iQOO Neo11 Ultra and Z11S debut in China
description: As expected, iQOO announced its Neo11 Ultra and Z11S in China today. Both phones come with MediaTek Dimensity chipsets and massive batteries while also boasting IP68/IP69 ingress protection. iQOO Neo11 Ultra Neo11 Ultra is equipped with the Dimensity 9500 Monster chipset, which is paired with iQOO’s Q2 gaming chip and up to 16GB LPDDR5X Ultra RAM and 512GB UFS 4.1 storage. Z11S gets the Dimensity 7500 paired with LPDDR4X RAM and UFS 3.1 storage. title: Poco M8x 5G's battery details revealed ahead of launch
description: Earlier this month, Poco launched the M8 Power in India with an 8,000mAh battery. The company then began teasing the M8x 5G in the country late last week. Now, Poco has revealed the battery capacity of the upcoming M8-series smartphone. The Poco M8x 5G will pack a 7,900mAh battery, the company confirmed via an official X post. It will also support 45W wired charging and 22.5W reverse wired charging. Poco confirmed yesterday that the M8x 5G will launch in India on August 21, while also revealing several key specifications. The smartphone will be powered by the Snapdragon 4 Gen 5...

title: The slim Moto Pad 70 is now available in India, here's how much it costs
description: A couple of weeks ago, Motorola unveiled the Moto Pad 70, which became the third member of the Pad 70 family. It is similar to the Moto Pad 70 Groove, which also has a 12.1” IPS LCD (but it’s 120Hz instead of 90Hz) – the main difference between these two is that the Groove packs a 9-unit JBL Pro Speaker System with a built-in kickstand on its back. Moto Pad 70 There are a few other differences, but the big news today is that the slimmer Pad 70 is now available in India. You can find it on Motorola.in as well as on Flipkart. Flipkart only has the 8/256GB model and it is priced...

title: CMF's new wireless earbuds will be unveiled on August 20
description: After announcing the CMF Clip Pro earbuds earlier this month and teasing a new product recently, Nothing sub-brand CMF has now confirmed that it’s unveiling the Buds Neo later this week. In a post on X, CMF by Nothing announced that the Buds Neo will be unveiled on August 20. A teaser video shared alongside the announcement offers a first look at the charging case, which appears to feature a smart dial similar to those found on other CMF audio products. The video also reveals the earbuds' color options. Buds Neo.20 August. pic.twitter.com/ZjfWxscOXE— CMF by Nothing...

title: Fairphone 6+ is now official and coming to the US
description: Fairphone has today announced its latest smartphone, the Fairphone 6+. It comes with 50% more RAM than the Fairphone 6 at 12GB vs. 8GB, and the newer Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 SoC. It's available in a new Cobalt Blue color, along with Forest Green and Horizon Black. These are the only changes from the Fairphone 6. Fairphone 6+ official images For the first time ever, a Fairphone device will be officially available in the US, from both Fairphone's online store and Amazon, with no caveats about it not running Android. title: Samsung Poland lists 7 SKUs for the Galaxy S26 FE
description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is on a roll – yesterday, the phone appeared on the Google Play Console and in a hands-on video. Now, the FE model has been listed in an official Samsung document. The PDF in question comes from Samsung Poland and concerns the terms and conditions for Samsung Care+, the company’s extra insurance plan. The document doesn’t reveal much, but it does list 7 model numbers for the Galaxy S26 FE. title: The Tecno Pova 8 Pro is now up on Flipkart, will launch in India later this week
description: Tecno unveiled the Pova 8 Pro last week, but the company kept launch details under wraps, saying only that it will debut in India on August 18 – that’s today! But no, the phone isn’t available yet. Sales in India will start on August 21 (Friday). Tecno has partnered with Flipkart to launch the phone and you can already visit the store pages and set up a notification to remind you on Friday. The 8/256GB model is priced ₹50,000 and the 12/512GB variant is ₹55,000. Note that there is a ₹3,000 instant cashback and no-cost EMI up to 18 months. The Tecno Pova 8 Pro comes in three...

title: Honor Pad 20 Pro announced with SD 8s Gen 4 and 10,100 mAh battery
description: The Honor Pad 20 made its debut back in May, and it is now getting a Pro counterpart with bumped-up specs. Honor Pad 20 Pro brings a more capable Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset alongside a 10,100mAh battery and a 12.1-inch IPS LCD. The panel offers 3K resolution (3,000 x 1,872px) with a 165Hz refresh rate and supports stylus input via the optional Honor Magic-Pencil 4s. Honor is also offering a Paperlike Edition of the Pad 20 Pro, which brings an anti-glare display for a more intuitive drawing and note-taking experience. title: Honor Robot Phone is now available in China
description: Following its announcement last week, Honor opened up the first round of open sales for the Robot Phone in China. The highly anticipated smartphone with a 200MP gimbal camera is now available from Honor’s official online store and partnering retailers with a starting price of CNY 9,999 for the 12/512GB trim. Based on today’s exchange rates, that amounts to about $1,483 or €1,281. Honor is also offering a 16GB RAM and 1TB storage version for CNY 12,999 ($1,928/€1,666). description: iQOO will introduce the Z11 in India on August 20, with a design and specs different from the Chinese and Malaysian Z11. iQOO has already revealed a few features of the Indian Z11, and it has now shared more details about the smartphone. iQOO has revealed that the Indian Z11 will sport a 32MP selfie camera on the front, while the dual-camera setup on the rear will comprise a 50MP primary (Sony IMX882, OIS, 26mm) and an 8MP (15mm) ultrawide-angle camera. description: Apple has been rumored to be working on AirPods with built-in cameras for some time now. Despite a recent rumor claiming that the so-called AirPods Ultra project has been cancelled, a new video has surfaced showing the camera-equipped AirPods in action. The demo video for the camera-equipped AirPods was discovered by MacRumors in the latest macOS 26.7 release candidate.
